[[File:Herb seed detail.png|left|140px]]
'''Guam seeds''' can be planted in a [[herb patch]] at level 9 [[Farming]] to yield [[Grimy guam leaf|grimy guam leaves]], which, when [[Herb#Cleaning grimy herbs|cleaned]], are used in [[Herblore]] to make [[potions]].

Nearby [[Group of Advanced Gardeners|gardeners]] will '''not''' watch over herb patches, nor will a fully-grown [[White lily (plant)|white lily plant]] protect them from [[Disease (Farming)|disease]].

They are obtainable from sources such as [[monster]]s, [[seed pack]]s, and [[Master Farmer|master farmers]]. Completing [[Garden of Tranquillity]] rewards 5 guam seeds.

One seed can be used on the [[Pet#Skilling pets|skilling pet]] [[Tangleroot]] to change its appearance.

==Farming info==
{{Farming page|Guam leaf (plant)}}
<references/>

===Average harvest yield===
Guam has a minimum of 3 [[Farming#Variable crop yield|harvest lives]], increasing by 1 for each tier of [[compost]] used (for a maximum of 6 when using [[ultracompost]]). While harvesting guam leaves, there is a chance to not consume a harvest life dependent on the player's Farming level. This chance scales from 10.2% at level 1 to 31.6% at level 99, interpolating linearly in between.
